title: 2023 ESC Guidelines for the Management of Acute Coronary Syndromes

definitions.STEMI: Persistent ST-segment elevation and acute total coronary occlusion
definitions.NSTEMI: Myocardial necrosis without persistent ST elevation; diagnosed by rise/fall of hs-cTn
definitions.GRACE Score: Global Registry of Acute Coronary Events mortality risk score
definitions.0h/1h algorithm: ESC rapid rule-out/rule-in protocol using hs-cTn at 0h and 1h
definitions.Primary PCI: Percutaneous coronary intervention as primary reperfusion in STEMI

recommendations.text: Primary PCI is recommended for STEMI within 120 minutes of first medical contact if available.
Fibrinolysis should be administered within 10 minutes of STEMI diagnosis when primary PCI cannot be performed within 120 minutes.
Aspirin 150–300 mg loading dose is recommended for all patients with ACS without contraindications.
P2Y12 inhibitor (ticagrelor or prasugrel preferred, clopidogrel if these not available) in addition to aspirin is recommended for ACS patients managed with PCI.
High-intensity statin therapy is recommended in all ACS patients regardless of baseline LDL-C, with LDL-C target <55 mg/dL.
If LDL-C ≥55 mg/dL on maximally tolerated statin, ezetimibe is recommended in addition.
If LDL-C ≥55 mg/dL on maximally tolerated statin + ezetimibe, PCSK9 inhibitor is recommended.
Beta-blockers are recommended in STEMI patients with LVEF ≤40% or HF.
ACEi is recommended for long-term therapy in ACS patients with HF, LVEF ≤40%, DM, or hypertension.
Early invasive strategy (<24h) is recommended for NSTE-ACS patients with at least one high-risk criterion (raised troponin, ST changes, GRACE >140).
Immediate invasive strategy (<2h) is recommended for NSTE-ACS with very-high-risk features (refractory angina, haemodynamic instability, arrhythmias).
The 0h/1h rapid rule-out/rule-in algorithm using hs-cTn is recommended for early triage in NSTE-ACS.
DAPT for 12 months is recommended after ACS with PCI, unless contraindicated by high bleeding risk.
MRA is recommended in ACS patients with LVEF ≤40% without severe renal dysfunction or hyperkalaemia.

hs_troponin_algorithms.0h_1h_rule_out: Both 0h and 1h hs-cTnI <5 ng/L (or assay-specific limit) → rule out NSTEMI
hs_troponin_algorithms.0h_1h_rule_in: 0h hs-cTnI ≥52 ng/L OR absolute delta ≥6 ng/L → rule in NSTEMI
hs_troponin_algorithms.observe: Values between rule-out and rule-in → observe 3h

pharmacotherapy.examples: ticagrelor 180 mg → 90 mg BID; prasugrel 60 mg → 10 mg daily
UFH bolus + infusion; enoxaparin 1 mg/kg SC BID; bivalirudin in PCI

key_trials.finding: 19% RRR but more major bleeding vs clopidogrel
